quotes.name: Adarkar Windform
quotes.flavor: Terisiare has only two kinds of weather: cold and weird.

quotes.name: Urza's Blueprints
quotes.flavor: From concept to paper to reality.

quotes.name: Selesnya Signet
quotes.flavor: The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

quotes.name: Crimson Wisps
quotes.flavor: The whispers are incomprehensible, yet cinders always hear a message of urgency.

quotes.name: Planar Collapse
quotes.flavor: With heavy heart, Urza doused one world's light to rekindle another's.

quotes.name: Vow of Duty
quotes.flavor:
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

quotes.name: Ancestral Communion
quotes.flavor:
"I am always here, my son. We all are."
—King T'Chaka

quotes.name: Open the Vaults
quotes.flavor:
"It may be time to leave, but I'll never forget the day you all entered Vault 76."
—Overseer

quotes.name: Thought-Knot Seer
quotes.flavor: It thinks, therefore you aren't.

quotes.name: Fade into Antiquity
quotes.flavor:
"Are the gods angry at our discontent with what they give us, or jealous that we made a thing they cannot?"
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

quotes.name: Skybeast Tracker
quotes.flavor: Cloud eaters, heaven tillers, beanstalk wurms—he favors prey worthy of a giant's appetite.

quotes.name: Goldnight Commander
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: "One faith, but many hands in victory."

quotes.name: Grievous Wound
quotes.flavor: Vicky was so tired. The pain began to fade. "You were so brave," said her grandmother's voice from somewhere far away. "But it's time to rest now."

quotes.name: Laboratory Maniac
quotes.flavor: His mind whirled with grand plans, never thinking of what might happen if he were to succeed.

quotes.name: Suq'Ata Firewalker
quotes.flavor:
"Comfortable even in a furnace? I've never met one who'd accept my wager."
—Talibah, embermage

quotes.name: Helpful Hunter
quotes.flavor:
"Ah, the conquering hero returns! What trials did you face, little one?"
—Basri Ket

quotes.name: Festergloom
quotes.flavor: The death of a scout can be as informative as a safe return.

quotes.name: Acidic Slime
quotes.flavor: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

quotes.name: Essence Vortex
quotes.flavor: Masters who sacrifice for servants will receive the gift of loyalty.

quotes.name: Heart Sliver
quotes.flavor: Gerrard looked all around for the source of the mysterious pulse, and at that moment the slivers boiled forth from the crevasses.

quotes.name: Riot Devils
quotes.flavor: Devils are demons' unearthly desires made flesh. Let loose on the world, they satisfy their mad craving for destruction in a whirlwind of chaos.

quotes.name: Dragonlord's Servant
quotes.flavor: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

quotes.name: Trailblazer's Boots
quotes.flavor: Electric footwear! The keeper of your creativity.

quotes.name: Curse of Thirst
quotes.flavor:
"May you drink until you drown but never be sated."
—Odila, witch of Morkrut

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

quotes.name: Vampiric Link
quotes.flavor: The familiar's fangs deliver the master's bite.

quotes.name: Voltaic Key
quotes.flavor: The key did not work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.

quotes.name: Courage in Crisis
quotes.flavor: "Thanks to my father, I know how to fight. He also showed me why I must."

quotes.name: Unstable Footing
quotes.flavor: A long way down is shorter than you think.

quotes.name: Flatline
quotes.flavor:
"We've found the missing people- they're in the walls!"
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Kruin Striker
quotes.flavor: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Odric, Master Tactician
quotes.flavor: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

quotes.name: Underrealm Lich
quotes.flavor: "You've strayed, overworlder."

quotes.name: Sarkhan's Rage
quotes.flavor: The people of Tarkir speak of an ancient legend, of the dragon-man called Sarkhan who was greatest of all khans.

quotes.name: Nightfire Giant
quotes.flavor: Nightfire turns the greatest weakness of the undead into formidable strength.

quotes.name: Cloudkin Seer
quotes.flavor: "I can see which way the wind is blowing."

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor: The remains of ancient civilizations litter the run-down land.

quotes.name: Snickering Squirrel
quotes.flavor: "In this line of work, you've got to know how to squirrel things away. Quite literally, in my case."

quotes.name: Spider-Woman, Stunning Savior
quotes.flavor: To know her is to fear her.

quotes.name: Mire's Toll
quotes.flavor: As the bridge snapped, Berko was sure he heard the swamp laughing at him.

quotes.name: Night's Whisper
quotes.flavor: "They were all laughing at you after you left, you know. How will you make them pay?"

quotes.name: Sword of Vengeance
quotes.flavor: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

quotes.name: Fire Prophecy
quotes.flavor:
"Water and bone tell many tales, but fire is fickle. It would rather consume than reveal."
—Rielle, the Everwise

quotes.name: Hungry Flames
quotes.flavor: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

quotes.name: Tuktuk the Explorer
quotes.flavor: Remade by Eldrazi magic, Tuktuk inspired an entire clan of misguided goblins.

quotes.name: Sword of the Animist
quotes.flavor: The blade glows only for Zendikar's chosen.

quotes.name: Evolution Sage
quotes.flavor: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

quotes.name: Indulgent Tormentor
quotes.flavor: The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.

quotes.name: Savage Lands
quotes.flavor: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

quotes.name: God-Pharaoh's Faithful
quotes.flavor: "This is the final trial! Rejoice, for the God-Pharaoh soars among us!"

quotes.name: Dive Down
quotes.flavor: "Seeing the river is not the same as seeing the fish."

quotes.name: Voracious Greatshark
quotes.flavor: There is no boat big enough.

quotes.name: Stupor
quotes.flavor:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: She died in this swamp, and so will you.

quotes.name: Ondu Giant
quotes.flavor: Some druids nurture gardens. Others nurture continents.

quotes.name: Infest
quotes.flavor:
"This is why we don't go out in banewasp weather."
—Rannon, Vithian holdout

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: A spark of resistance against a tide of corruption.

quotes.name: Druid of the Cowl
quotes.flavor: "The wild tangle of the Cowl provides sanctuary to life that watched the first buildings rise."

quotes.name: Battle at the Bridge
quotes.flavor:
"This is bigger than you. All of you."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Floodfarm Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Mistmoors slump like a grieving parent, the once-thriving fields drowned by the relentless deluge.

quotes.name: Frozen Shade
quotes.flavor: "There are some qualities—some incorporate things,/ That have a double life, which thus is made/ A type of twin entity which springs/ From matter and light, evinced in solid and shade." —Edgar Allan Poe, "Silence"

quotes.name: Spark Reaper
quotes.flavor:
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it."
—Kaya

quotes.name: Creeping Corrosion
quotes.flavor:
"We will reveal the futility of their heresy by showing them how fragile their relics are."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

quotes.name: Explosive Getaway
quotes.flavor: Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
「侵略の血まみれの喧騒が消え
そして再び静かな歌が森の中に鳴り響く。」
—-「フレイアリーズの歌」

quotes.name: Ancestral Mask
quotes.flavor: The masks, like the ancient trees they're grown from, lend strength to the dryads.

quotes.name: Glimpse of Nature
quotes.flavor: Dosan sat in repose for many hours. He made no motion, no sound at all. And as he sat, nature revealed itself to him.

quotes.name: Greater Mossdog
quotes.flavor: Man's best fungus.

quotes.name: Valiant Knight
quotes.flavor: "Defeat is no reason for retreat. It is a sign we must redouble our efforts to win this fight."

quotes.name: Zombify
quotes.flavor:
"El primer nacimiento celebra la vida. El segundo nacimiento se burla de ella."
—Anciano místico

quotes.name: Kodama's Reach
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

quotes.name: Mind Rot
quotes.flavor:
"The beauty of mental attacks is that your victims never remember them."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Wu Elite Cavalry
quotes.flavor: At the second battle of Ruxu, the brave Wu general Gan Ning raided Cao Cao's camp of 400,000 men with only 100 cavalry. Not a single man or horse was lost.

quotes.name: Trelasarra, Moon Dancer
quotes.flavor: "Eilistraee teaches us that we are not bound by the circumstances of our birth. We all may find beauty and light, if we have the courage to seek them."

quotes.name: Goblin Razerunners
quotes.flavor: Finding an unexplored world, they immediately set it on fire.

quotes.name: Delighted Halfling
quotes.flavor: There were toys the Hobbit-children had never seen before, all beautiful, and some obviously magical.

quotes.name: Merciless Executioner
quotes.flavor: "Curse the Isengarders! Uglúk u bagronk sha pushdug Saruman-glob búbhosh skai!"

quotes.name: Final Reward
quotes.flavor: Those who earn a glorious death are given the highest honor. They are carried on funeral barges through the gate to the afterlife.

quotes.name: Ogre Battledriver
quotes.flavor: Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.

quotes.name: Mortuary
quotes.flavor:
"Think of them not as failures but as works in progress."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Pithing Needle
quotes.flavor: The fearful want the procedure before a blood festival. The guilty seek it afterward.

quotes.name: Gleam of Battle
quotes.flavor: Every soldier returns from battle changed: by hardship, by blood, by a glimpse of glory.

quotes.name: Cutthroat il-Dal
quotes.flavor: Her blades slashed across the noble's shadow. He scoffed, then fell over dead.

quotes.name: Chandra's Pyrohelix
quotes.flavor:
"Now that I've dealt with your little toys, I can focus on the real problem: you."
—Chandra Nalaar, to Dovin Baan

quotes.name: Flamekin Brawler
quotes.flavor: When he hits people, they stay hit.

quotes.name: Diver Skaab
quotes.flavor: It doesn't need to breathe, but the suit does help keep the parts together.

quotes.name: Reckless Scholar
quotes.flavor: Progress comes at a price.

quotes.name: Holy Day
quotes.flavor:
"Hoy hay fiesta y paz en nuestra tierra, pero la guerra no terminó. Guarda tu sed de sangre. La necesitarás mañana."
—Karrim, sanador samita

quotes.name: Flying Carpet
quotes.flavor: Woven from strands of griffin mane and pegasus tail.

quotes.name: Sibsig Appraiser
quotes.flavor: "Oh, I can absolutely verify its authenticity," chuckled Sarnai. "I was there when it was made."

quotes.name: Anaconda
quotes.flavor: You'll never find an anaconda in a swamp. It will always find you first.

quotes.name: Brass Infiniscope
quotes.flavor: Styluses are tools used by students to channel their magic. For young Quandrix mages, they can help navigate difficult calculations and focus perspective.

quotes.name: Murasa Sproutling
quotes.flavor: The seeds of memory grow eternal.

quotes.name: Black Waltz No. 3
quotes.flavor: "You fool. Do I look like some lowly black mage soldier?"

quotes.name: Surge of Brilliance
quotes.flavor: "They may have superior numbers, but we have superior minds."

quotes.name: Corpse Augur
quotes.flavor: Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.

quotes.name: Timberwatch Elf
quotes.flavor: Even through the Mirari's voice, the elves still hear the call of their kinship.

quotes.name: Shanodin Dryads
quotes.flavor: Where dryads dance, seeds sprout and flowers bloom.

quotes.name: Intangible Virtue
quotes.flavor: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

quotes.name: Bottle Gnomes
quotes.flavor: Reinforcements . . . or refreshments?

quotes.name: Vexilus Praetor
quotes.flavor: There is no greater bulwark than the Praetors of the Adeptus Custodes, the bodyguards of the Emperor of Mankind.

quotes.name: Victimize
quotes.flavor:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Merfolk Thaumaturgist
quotes.flavor:
"Blasted fishtails! It's not enough that they meddle with my head, but they twist my body as well."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Defiant Ogre
quotes.flavor: "I have no clan, but I still have purpose."

quotes.name: Burning Fields
quotes.flavor:
"In raiding and plundering, be like fire, in immovability like a mountain."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

quotes.name: Utopia Tree
quotes.flavor: The fruit of this fabled tree takes on the flavor of whatever food you love most.

quotes.name: Supper for Spiders
quotes.flavor: The spiders laughed. "You were quite right," they said, "the meat's alive and kicking!"

quotes.name: Goblin Mime
quotes.flavor: Mung noticed a few clouds gathering in the sky. Perhaps today he could perform his "walking against the wind" routine.

quotes.name: Cryptic Gateway
quotes.flavor: Its lock changes to fit each key.

quotes.name: Urborg Volcano
quotes.flavor: Deep in the heart of Urborg lie massive volcanoes whose thick black smoke covers the land with perpetual darkness.

quotes.name: General's Enforcer
quotes.flavor:
"A veteran ranger inspires awe. Stick around for when they get here, you'll see."
—NCR trooper

quotes.name: Ethereal Haze
quotes.flavor:
"Imagine a dove flying through smoke. Does the dove injure the smoke? Does the smoke impede the dove?"
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

quotes.name: Underground River
quotes.flavor:
"But stream and pool is wet and cool: so nice for feet! We only wish to catch a fish, so juicy-sweet!"
—Gollum

quotes.name: Kaervek's Spite
quotes.flavor:
"The end justifies the means. What do I care if I rule over the dead rather than over the living? The dead ask fewer questions."
—Kaervek

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor:
All that is gold does not glitter,
Not all those who wander are lost;
The old that is strong does not wither,
Deep roots are not reached by the frost.

quotes.name: Creeperhulk
quotes.flavor:
"I saw the devastation when the juggernauts crashed the walls of An Karras. Then I got to thinking."
—Janji, sylvan druid

quotes.name: Wargate
quotes.flavor: Bant mages still call to the heavens for aid, but angels are not the only ones who answer.

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

quotes.name: Drunau Corpse Trawler
quotes.flavor: Seagrafs yield an abundance of resources for stitchers and ghoulcallers alike.

quotes.name: Lightwalker
quotes.flavor:
"The greatest gift Dromoka gives is the ability to fly without wings."
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Y'shtola Rhul
quotes.flavor: "As I suspected, the aetheric disturbance here is no natural occurrence."

quotes.name: Spider-Girl, Legacy Hero
quotes.flavor: On Earth-982, May "Mayday" Parker, the first child of Peter and Mary Jane, continues her father's legacy.

quotes.name: Emrakul, the Promised End
quotes.flavor: An enigma as vexing as life itself.

quotes.name: Academy Manufactor
quotes.flavor: Automated systems at the Tolarian Academy sort new acquisitions for optimal use, determining which should be studied, eaten, or sold.

quotes.name: Trustworthy Scout
quotes.flavor: "Don't worry. If you lose me I'll be right behind you."

quotes.name: Grove of the Burnwillows
quotes.flavor: Spring is the most beautiful season in the grove, when the new leaves open from their ember-buds in a race of leaping flames.

quotes.name: Carnassid
quotes.flavor: The hunter would never forget the time or place where he first met the carnassid, for they buried him there.

quotes.name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
quotes.flavor: "A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."

quotes.name: Air Elemental
quotes.flavor: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild, and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

quotes.name: Dragon Engine
quotes.flavor: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

quotes.name: Battle of Wits
quotes.flavor: The wizard who reads a thousand books is powerful. The wizard who memorizes a thousand books is insane.

quotes.name: Chain Reaction
quotes.flavor:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

quotes.name: Languish
quotes.flavor: Life is such a fragile thing.

quotes.name: Pack Attack
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Kobold tactics rarely account for little things like diplomacy, mercy, or surrender.

quotes.name: Vampire Revenant
quotes.flavor:
"A thick fog obscures the port of Leor, but it's not thick enough to muffle the screams."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Biosynthic Burst
quotes.flavor:
Maybe in your next evolution.
—Eumidian insult

quotes.name: Kor Halberd
quotes.flavor: An ancient weapon for a modern war.

quotes.name: Storm Crow
quotes.flavor: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

quotes.name: Impervious Greatwurm
quotes.flavor: The ultimate answer to intrigue and subtlety.

quotes.name: Yavimaya Enchantress
quotes.flavor: Her roots connect her to the forest's wishes.

quotes.name: Archangel
quotes.flavor:
"My mother once told me angels sing their swords' names with each strike."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Dutiful Thrull
quotes.flavor:
"They are useful, but there's little satisfaction in supplication that throws itself under your heel."
—Jozica, Orzhov enforcer

quotes.name: Chalk Outline
quotes.flavor:
"In your search for a suspect, never forget that the most important person is the victim."
—Ezrim, Agency chief

quotes.name: Coral Eel
quotes.flavor: Some fishers like to eat eels, and some eels like to eat fishers.

quotes.name: The Frightful Four
quotes.flavor:
"Turn, Reed Richards! Turn and face those who will destroy you!"
—Wizard

quotes.name: Cutthroat Contender
quotes.flavor: The fights may sometimes be rigged, but the front-row spectators know the wounds are real.

quotes.name: Hylda's Crown of Winter
quotes.flavor: With each day she wore the crown, her icy kingdom spread, and her heart grew ever colder.

quotes.name: Slaughter the Strong
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: It was a big day for the gravediggers at Cliffside Cemetery.

quotes.name: Vicious Rivalry
quotes.flavor: So intense was their hatred they didn't realize how lonely they'd become. In the end, all they had was each other, and they hated that, too.

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Blessing
quotes.flavor:
"Virtue can't survive without strength."
—Ardanna of the Angelic Council

quotes.name: Splitting the Powerstone
quotes.flavor: As the glowing stone broke apart, so too did the last shred of the brothers' bond.

quotes.name: Shrapnel Blast
quotes.flavor: From trinket to trauma.

quotes.name: Plague Beetle
quotes.flavor: No one knows whether they were named for the disease they carry or for the speed at which they multiply.

quotes.name: Fists of the Anvil
quotes.flavor: Gron's mind reeled with possibilities, most of which are best left unmentioned.

quotes.name: Return the Past
quotes.flavor:
"You're back! You're in my head. All my memories... are back."
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Paradoxical Outcome
quotes.flavor: The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.

quotes.name: Kor Dirge
quotes.flavor: Every new evincar cements their power with a culling as the weak are purged anew from Rath.

quotes.name: Wall of Stone
quotes.flavor: The ground itself lends its strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

quotes.name: Earthquake
quotes.flavor: They fell screaming into the depths of the chasm like so many pebbles tossed down a well.

quotes.name: Jodah, Archmage Eternal
quotes.flavor:
"Chronicles across the ages describe Jodah. They likely refer not to one mage, but to a family or an arcane title."
—Arkol, Argivian scholar

quotes.name: Diabolic Tutor
quotes.flavor: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

quotes.name: Frostweb Spider
quotes.flavor: Its white webs glitter, mimicking the frost on the tree's branches.

quotes.name: Diabolic Tutor
quotes.flavor: The best ideas often come from the worst minds.

quotes.name: Fetid Pools
quotes.flavor:
"Whoever holds the Source controls the destiny of the planet."
—Cobb

quotes.name: Spirit Link
quotes.flavor: "We are all inextricably linked, souls woven in tapestry."

quotes.name: Duelist's Heritage
quotes.flavor: The best techniques outlive their creators.

quotes.name: Emissary Escort
quotes.flavor: Emissary mechans are often assigned their own security detail given their importance in inter-Pinnacle dialogs.

quotes.name: Spectral Searchlight
quotes.flavor: The first searchlights were given as gifts, symbols of cooperation, to the emissaries present at the signing of the Guildpact.

quotes.name: Daraja Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"And the flamingos said, 'Get out of our nest—we can't be seen with the likes of you!' So, the griffin ate them."
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

quotes.name: Updraft Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"It slips through the smallest cracks in the mountain, emerging whole and unfettered. There is nowhere it cannot go, for what can hold back the air itself?"
—Chanyi, Ojutai monk

quotes.name: Ulamog's Crusher
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever the Eldrazi's purpose is, it has nothing to do with something so insignificant as us."
—Nirthu, lone missionary

quotes.name: Silverquill Pledgemage
quotes.flavor: "I avoid violence. It is the last resort of the witless. But if you insist, I'll make an exception for you."

quotes.name: Deathbellow Raider
quotes.flavor:
"The temple has been rededicated. It belongs to Mogis now."
—Rastos, disciple of Mogis

quotes.name: Murder of Crows
quotes.flavor: Even more than carrion, they crave the last words of the dying.

quotes.name: Disenchant
quotes.flavor: Even millennia later, some war machines from the devastating Brothers' War continue to function. Thankfully, the weapons meant to destroy them still work too.

quotes.name: Homunculus Horde
quotes.flavor:
"To whoever left their homunculus experiment unattended: you will not be penalized if you come forward and tell us how to make it stop."
—Laboratory notice

quotes.name: Crystal Dragon // Rob the Hoard
quotes.flavor:
"Wait, it was just guarding a bunch of eggs! Where is the treasure?"
—Xalcorin the bard

quotes.name: Taunt from the Rampart
quotes.flavor:
"Wotta revoltin' development."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

quotes.name: Slaughterhouse Bouncer
quotes.flavor: A Rakdos party is a flop if anyone lives to talk about it.

quotes.name: Arcanis the Omnipotent
quotes.flavor: "Do not concern yourself with my origin, my race, or my ancestry. Seek my record in the pits, and then make your wager."

quotes.name: Jund Hackblade
quotes.flavor: The knights were halfway through their precombat rites before they realized the foul brute meant to start without them.

quotes.name: Crowd of True Believers
quotes.flavor: Being a hero is easy when you know who you're fighting for.

quotes.name: Bonders' Enclave
quotes.flavor: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

quotes.name: Maeve, Insidious Singer
quotes.flavor: Her haunting tune drowns out the percussion of snapping masts.

quotes.name: Armillary Sphere
quotes.flavor: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

quotes.name: Glen Elendra Liege
quotes.flavor: Those who displease Oona soon learn the extent of the armies she commands.

quotes.name: Mind Rot
quotes.flavor:
"The beauty of mental attacks is that your victims never remember them."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Generous Gift
quotes.flavor: The appearance of large beasts from faraway lands remains a debate between animalfolk communities.

quotes.name: Vivisection
quotes.flavor: Phyrexians research with the grace of surgeons and the finesse of butchers.

quotes.name: Fumigate
quotes.flavor:
"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer

quotes.name: Aven of Enduring Hope
quotes.flavor: "This storm will calm. We must believe that."

quotes.name: Thran Dynamo
quotes.flavor: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

quotes.name: Familiar Ground
quotes.flavor: More than any other battlefield, the forest gives the advantage to those who know it best.

quotes.name: Jacked Rabbit
quotes.flavor: "Squash. What it is and what it does."

quotes.name: Munitions Enthusiast
quotes.flavor: "There is nothing shameful about falling before a superior enemy, human!"

quotes.name: Teeming Dragonstorm
quotes.flavor:
"So, these dragons intend to also manifest through a sandstorm? I take some offense to that."
—Felothar, khan of the Abzan

quotes.name: Big Score
quotes.flavor: "Unimaginable riches? I assure you, I have a *vivid* imagination."

quotes.name: Crested Sunmare
quotes.flavor:
"It is evidence that some pure corner of the world must still exist."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

quotes.name: Harmonic Prodigy
quotes.flavor: Each note strikes with deadly precision.

quotes.name: It That Gets Left Hanging
quotes.flavor: "Give me . . . some skin."

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: The power to draw on the wisdom of your allies at any time, from any place . . . or trade cat pics!

quotes.name: Orzhov Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"We do not believe in hiding our wealth in the shadows. This is Orzhov, and this is how we reward greatness."
—Teysa Karlov, Grand Envoy of Orzhov

quotes.name: Beast Within
quotes.flavor:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
—Euphemia, Nexus watcher

quotes.name: Lambholt Harrier
quotes.flavor:
"This Tovolar is no brainless brute. He sends his howling minions to terrorize a village for months. Sleepless nights and fear take their toll. Only then, when morale is at its worst, does he strike."
—Barnes, village watch

quotes.name: Shivan Oasis
quotes.flavor: Only the hardiest explorers survive to eat the fruit.

quotes.name: Opportunity
quotes.flavor:
"He cocooned himself alone in his workshop for months. When he finally emerged, all broad grins and excited chatter, I knew he'd found his answer."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Grey Host Reinforcements
quotes.flavor:
"I hope they haven't forgotten how to fight."
—Gimli

quotes.name: Private Eye
quotes.flavor: "Yep. It's a vase, all right."

quotes.name: Lys Alana Scarblade
quotes.flavor: In beauty-obsessed Lys Alana, one cut of her blade means the difference between a high society feast and raking through the dungheap for scraps.

quotes.name: Snow Mercy
quotes.flavor: WARNING: Shake gently. Contents may cause choking, hypothermia, and/or planar invasion.

quotes.name: Lotleth Troll
quotes.flavor: He lurks in the undercity, eager for the corpse haulers to unload their rotting cargo.

quotes.name: Woodborn Behemoth
quotes.flavor: It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.

quotes.name: Soul's Attendant
quotes.flavor: In truth, her own faith was gone, trodden in Ulamog's wake. She pantomimed the blessing in the hope that it would inspire others to continue to struggle.

quotes.name: Cost of Brilliance
quotes.flavor:
"There will be moments when you are exhausted, with nothing left to give. Remember them when you finally succeed."
—Embrose, dean of shadow

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor:
"Cheap and nasty time travel."
—Missy

quotes.name: Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist
quotes.flavor: "With the right tools, even the sky is within reach."

quotes.name: Zhalfirin Void
quotes.flavor:
"The wind whispers, 'come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Serpentine Ambush
quotes.flavor: The merchant did guarantee the new bait would bring in something big.

quotes.name: Mineshaft Spider
quotes.flavor: Anything that falls into the pit—relics, rubble, even corpses—ends up snared in its magic-infused web.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor:
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind."
—Gadwick, the Wizened

quotes.name: Sami, Wildcat Captain
quotes.flavor: "The hard way it is."

quotes.name: Spear Spewer
quotes.flavor:
"Don't waste time aiming, you lazy gob-slug! Fire!"
—Krenko, mob boss

quotes.name: Storm Herd
quotes.flavor:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

quotes.name: Council's Judgment
quotes.flavor: When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.

quotes.name: Meria, Scholar of Antiquity
quotes.flavor: "Why fear artifice? Is it not also of this world?"

quotes.name: Orzhov Advokist
quotes.flavor: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

quotes.name: Darksteel Forge
quotes.flavor:
"Did it have this shape upon Mirrodin's creation, or did some inconceivable force shape the unshapable?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher

quotes.name: Arcbound Worker
quotes.flavor: The parts are as strong as the whole.

quotes.name: Federation Field Medic
quotes.flavor: "Stop whining. Sto-Vo-Kor will be there later."

quotes.name: Seton, Krosan Protector
quotes.flavor: "Survival of the fittest is not only the law of the pits, it is the law of nature. That is why I fight."

quotes.name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
quotes.flavor: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

quotes.name: Erratic Portal
quotes.flavor: "In Barrin's name!" cried Lyna as Hanna's sword passed through her, "Ertai sends word that the portal is open—but not for long!"

quotes.name: Ironclad Krovod
quotes.flavor:
"We need to block the exits from the plaza! What's big, heavy, and available?"
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Path of Anger's Flame
quotes.flavor:
"Walking the path of the kami only leaves you with singed feet."
—Soratami saying

quotes.name: Mannichi, the Fevered Dream
quotes.flavor:
"Early in his reign, Konda fell ill. His head burned with fever, and he saw visions of his future. In them, he saw a spirit-child, and, in that child's eyes, a way to make his empire last forever."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Riftsweeper
quotes.flavor: "Beings of the rifts are not natural. No longer will these abominations tread upon the body of Gaea."

quotes.name: Coretapper
quotes.flavor: It converts the faintest surges of power from Mirrodin's core into usable energy, providing endless power for Memnarch's creations on the surface.

quotes.name: Cruel Ultimatum
quotes.flavor: There is always a greater power.

quotes.name: Futurist Forge
quotes.flavor:
"You saw what I built in a cave. Imagine what I can do here."
—Tony Stark

quotes.name: Iron Verdict
quotes.flavor: "You'll raid nothing but mist in Istfell."

quotes.name: Dakmor Lancer
quotes.flavor: The darkness of his shield reflects the inky blackness of his soul.

quotes.name: Fireslinger
quotes.flavor:
"One pain is lessened by another's anguish."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

quotes.name: Night's Whisper
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

quotes.name: Doomsday Excruciator
quotes.flavor: "All stars grow dark. All worlds come to an end."

quotes.name: Curse of Shaken Faith
quotes.flavor: Even within the chapel's hallowed halls, the devils' laughter pierced his prayers.

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.flavor: A skeletal wall, strengthened by the souls of traitors, rings the city of the Eastern Paladin.

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor:
"When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas."
—Kiora

quotes.name: Hymn to Tourach
quotes.flavor: The priests plead for your anguish and pray for your despair.

quotes.name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

quotes.name: Spawning Bed
quotes.flavor: Young Eldrazi crawl forth from the dust, compelled by a greater will.

quotes.name: Toil to Renown
quotes.flavor: The last survivor of her patrol, the warrior returned expecting disappointment and scorn. Instead she found gratitude. "You are alive. That is reason to celebrate."

quotes.name: Nantuko Husk
quotes.flavor:
The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Viashino Bladescout
quotes.flavor: "Find your courage in a desperate moment, and you turn the tide of history. So sayeth the bey."

quotes.name: Obeka, Brute Chronologist
quotes.flavor: "I'm bored with now."

quotes.name: Cascade Bluffs
quotes.flavor: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

quotes.name: Defiant Salvager
quotes.flavor: "I didn't survive that crash just so I could fall to the likes of you."

quotes.name: Spikeshot Elder
quotes.flavor: Now that he knows a thousand ways of hurting people, his next shamanic quest is to discover a thousand more.

quotes.name: Clairvoyance
quotes.flavor:
"As we followed the ice wall, we had the distinct feeling of being watched. Many of the party wanted to turn back."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Invasion of Pyrulea // Gargantuan Slabhorn
quotes.flavor: To the slabhorn, the branches of the Invasion Tree were as brittle as the stems of a Pyrulean fern.

quotes.name: Verdant Sun's Avatar
quotes.flavor:
"Ixalli's fertile rays enliven us all. Each of us is a testament to the sun's strength and love."
—Chitlati, Lightning Rider

quotes.name: Baloth Null
quotes.flavor:
"Humans use pigs to hunt for mushrooms, don't they? It's like that."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

quotes.name: Mothrider Samurai
quotes.flavor: When the night blossoms open, the wings of Eiganjo take flight.

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
quotes.flavor: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."

quotes.name: Kjeldoran War Cry
quotes.flavor: King Darien's breath crystallized and fell to the frozen battlefield, but its command carried true to all soldiers of New Argive.

quotes.name: Death Baron
quotes.flavor: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

quotes.name: Elderfang Disciple
quotes.flavor: "One day, the great serpent will rejoin us on Skemfar, and those who've wronged us will taste of our venom."

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Skyknight
quotes.flavor:
"My Aesthir is my most trusted ally. We fight as one and live as one, and we will die as one."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

quotes.name: Plague Rats
quotes.flavor:
"Should you a Rat to madness tease
Why ev'n a Rat may plague you..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

quotes.name: Languish
quotes.flavor: It seemed to the tenders of the sick that on the Halfling and on the Lady of Rohan this malady lay heavily. Soon they began to fall down into the darkness, and as the sun turned west, a grey shadow crept over their faces.

quotes.name: Thieving Magpie
quotes.flavor: Other birds collect twigs for their nests. Magpies steal jewels for theirs.

quotes.name: Painful Quandary
quotes.flavor:
"For each word spoken, one forgotten. For each thought, a memory rotten."
—Moriok incantation

quotes.name: Siegecraft
quotes.flavor:
"They thought their fortress impregnable . . . until we marched up with ours, and blocked out the sun."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

quotes.name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
quotes.flavor: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

quotes.name: Waltz of Rage
quotes.flavor: The melody was all in her head, but she'd always preferred to dance alone.

quotes.name: Vastwood Animist
quotes.flavor: He calls on the forests for counsel and summons the earth to his cause.

quotes.name: Fertile Ground
quotes.flavor: The forest was too lush for the brothers to despoil—almost.

quotes.name: Terror of the Peaks
quotes.flavor: Kogan likes dragons for their terrible majesty.

quotes.name: Gerrard's Battle Cry
quotes.flavor: Gerrard grinned and drew his sword. "This won't be a fair fight," he called to his crew. "They should have brought a second ship!"

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor: The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.

quotes.name: Artful Looter
quotes.flavor: PRICELESS PIC PILFERED Painting Found Abandoned in Graveyard Merfolk Decry Wizards' Treatment

quotes.name: Spire of Industry
quotes.flavor: Atop the tallest tower in the Commonwealth resides Fist, the leader of the super mutants, and his prized prisoners: Strong and Rex.

quotes.name: Zamriel, Seraph of Steel
quotes.flavor: Armored in courage and armed with searing light, her legion stands unflinching against the forces of darkness.

quotes.name: Eviscerator
quotes.flavor: It roamed the time bubble like a captured animal. Kerrick knew he must soon find a way to unleash it on Tolaria or destroy it.

quotes.name: Darkmoss Bridge
quotes.flavor: The path to power is forged in ruthlessness.

quotes.name: Palisade Giant
quotes.flavor: Refusing guild allegiances, she fights for those who can't protect themselves.

quotes.name: Barbed Lightning
quotes.flavor: Every creature on Mirrodin is a lightning rod.

quotes.name: Wall of Brambles
quotes.flavor:
Sleeping in brambles
—Elven phrase meaning "plagued by guilt"

quotes.name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
quotes.flavor: "Gix failed. I shall not."

quotes.name: Candlelight Vigil
quotes.flavor: Selesnya guildmages do not sleep so the rest of the conclave can.

quotes.name: Expedite
quotes.flavor: "I run, and thunder follows."

quotes.name: Divine Visitation
quotes.flavor: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.

quotes.name: Nomadic Elf
quotes.flavor: "I've journeyed across Dominaria. Phyrexians are everywhere. Plague is everywhere. There's no place left to hide."

quotes.name: Dreamshaper Shaman
quotes.flavor: Magic is the true artist's medium.

quotes.name: Call for Aid
quotes.flavor:
"We must hasten. The beacons of Gondor are alight. War is kindled."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Faerie Vandal
quotes.flavor: History may be written by the triumphant, but it's often rewritten by the troublesome.

quotes.name: Paradoxical Outcome
quotes.flavor: The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.

quotes.name: Pteron Ghost
quotes.flavor: Defending to the death isn't always enough.

quotes.name: Celestial Kirin
quotes.flavor: All bow at its visitation—some in awe, some in honor, some in fear.

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
"To this day, I have no idea if the heavens were obeying him or attacking him."
—Ral Zarek, research notes

quotes.name: Battlefly Swarm
quotes.flavor: Having encountered the bitter Phyrexian battleflies before, Squee knew not to bother eating them—or at least to stop after the fifth.

quotes.name: Hallowed Fountain
quotes.flavor: The ever-watchful center of a growing web of eyes.

quotes.name: Devil K. Nevil
quotes.flavor: "Danger is my middle name. Also, I don't know how to spell."

quotes.name: Elder Land Wurm
quotes.flavor: Sometimes it's best to let sleeping dragons lie.

quotes.name: Nomad Outpost
quotes.flavor:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Omenport Vigilante
quotes.flavor: Freestriders took to patrolling near the Omenpaths, protecting new arrivals from the robbers and charlatans prowling for easy marks.

quotes.name: Keening Apparition
quotes.flavor: Some souls are too damaged to be of use to the Orzhov.

quotes.name: Soldevi Simulacrum
quotes.flavor: They look human—until they bleed.

quotes.name: Scorchmark
quotes.flavor: "Have you seen your face? Trust me, this will be an improvement."

quotes.name: Seat of the Synod
quotes.flavor: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

quotes.name: Walking Corpse
quotes.flavor:
"Feeding a normal army is a problem of logistics. With zombies, it is an asset. Feeding is why they fight. Feeding is why they are feared."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

quotes.name: La Forge, Perceptive Engineer
quotes.flavor: "Captain, the sensor sweep is fine, but my VISOR is picking up some disturbing fluctuations in the dilithium crystal matrix."

quotes.name: Distant Melody
quotes.flavor: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

quotes.name: Striped Riverwinder
quotes.flavor: The denizens of the Luxa River woke angry on the currents of blood.

quotes.name: The Fifth Doctor
quotes.flavor: "When did you last have the pleasure of smelling a flower, watching a sunset, eating a well-prepared meal?"

quotes.name: Tegan Jovanka
quotes.flavor: "You certainly know how to fly this crate, don't you?"

quotes.name: Plague Rats
quotes.flavor:
"Should you a Rat to madness tease Why ev'n a Rat may plague you . . . ."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

quotes.name: Ajani's Mantra
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor:
"He hasn't returned to the Cloud Forest. But I can still sense his calming presence."
—Zaliki of Naya

quotes.name: Tamiyo's Journal
quotes.flavor: Entry 434: There's more to Avacyn's madness . . .

quotes.name: Slate of Ancestry
quotes.flavor: The pattern of life can be studied like a book, if you know how to read it.

quotes.name: Military Intelligence
quotes.flavor: To know the battlefield is to anticipate the enemy. To know the enemy is to anticipate victory.

quotes.name: Mage Slayer
quotes.flavor:
"When the wielder is strong enough, any sword will do."
—Kresh the Bloodbraided

quotes.name: Jill, Shiva's Dominant // Shiva, Warden of Ice
quotes.flavor: "I will be your monster no more."

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Valley Questcaller
quotes.flavor: No battle is fought, or won, alone.

quotes.name: Karakas
quotes.flavor: 2020 Legacy Champion

quotes.name: Beloved Chaplain
quotes.flavor: Nomad and Nantuko, eagle and elephant; all the birds and beasts are charmed by his quiet dignity.

quotes.name: Behind the Scenes
quotes.flavor: It does no good to bar the gate when the enemy is already inside.

quotes.name: Ankle Shanker
quotes.flavor: The stature of the fighter matters less than the depth of the cut.

quotes.name: Prismatic Ending
quotes.flavor:
"Some claim the archaics can die only after Arcavios's demise. Others claim their deaths herald the plane's doom. The truth? Only time will tell."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

quotes.name: Urza, Prince of Kroog
quotes.flavor: The prince consort was happy to let Yotia's coffers fund his extravagant research.

quotes.name: Sage of Lat-Nam
quotes.flavor: Within each device is a spark of its creator's soul. Within each sage is a lamp that awaits that spark.

quotes.name: Chitin Gravestalker
quotes.flavor: The Speedbrood doesn't differentiate between salvage and carrion.

quotes.name: Bontu's Monument
quotes.flavor:
"The worthy shall strive for greatness. Supremacy in life leads to supremacy in the afterlife."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Rhox Brute
quotes.flavor:
"In this new world, I have seen the once-devout rhoxes take up arms with the savages of Jund. I would be offended, but I see the wisdom in their choice."
—Gernan, Dawnray archer

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: The smallest seed of regret can bloom into redemption.

quotes.name: Flashfreeze
quotes.flavor:
"Your downfall was not your ignorance, your weakness, or your hubris, but your warm blood."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

quotes.name: Song of the Dryads
quotes.flavor: Few who encounter the strange, human-like grove leave once the lilting chorus of the dryads reaches their ears.

quotes.name: Malamet Veteran
quotes.flavor: The mightiest Malamet warriors train as titan-killers, elite champions capable of facing down the caverns' most fearsome beasts.

quotes.name: Pilfered Plans
quotes.flavor: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze, draining the chances of the other guilds.

quotes.name: Rabid Bloodsucker
quotes.flavor: She haunts the streets, wings spread wide, with carrion on her breath and blood in her eyes.

quotes.name: Autochthon Wurm
quotes.flavor: The trainer awoke to begin the journey from the wurm's tail to its head. The sun was setting when she arrived.

quotes.name: Dutiful Attendant
quotes.flavor: The dragon who eats the last head in the basket is entitled to the servant's.

quotes.name: Master Biomancer
quotes.flavor: "Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."

quotes.name: In Garruk's Wake
quotes.flavor: Beyond pain, beyond obsession and wild despair, there lies a place of twisted power only the most tormented souls can reach.

quotes.name: Call of the Conclave
quotes.flavor: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

quotes.name: Raise the Alarm
quotes.flavor: Like blinking or breathing, responding to an alarm is an involuntary reflex.

quotes.name: Spellskite
quotes.flavor: It craves attention. Feed it.

quotes.name: Roc Egg
quotes.flavor: A thin shell lies between the roc and a world of bite-sized treats.

quotes.name: Imperiosaur
quotes.flavor:
"An ancient, powerful force has overtaken the valley. I sympathize for its former inhabitants, but I rejoice for the land itself."
—Olanti, Muraganda druid

quotes.name: Thieving Otter
quotes.flavor:
"You're telling me we spent a year securing the sanctuary against pterosaurs, rambeasts, and nightfangs . . . and we were robbed by what?"
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

quotes.name: Fiend Hunter
quotes.flavor:
"What roads would any dare to tread if the Dúnedain were all gone into the grave?"
—Aragorn

quotes.name: Bone Flute
quotes.flavor: After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashioned the first such instrument out of Lord Ursnell's left leg.

quotes.name: Welding Sparks
quotes.flavor:
"The fires of invention burn in all of us. I fight for the freedom to unleash those flames."
—Pia Nalaar

quotes.name: Hanna's Custody
quotes.flavor:
"I protect the Legacy with my life if necessary, for its purpose is far more important than my own."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Bumi Bash
quotes.flavor: "You thought I was a frail old man, but I'm the most powerful Earthbender you'll ever see."

quotes.name: Magmatic Hellkite
quotes.flavor: It gulps from the lava flow to spew gouts of molten rock upon its prey.

quotes.name: Pitchburn Devils
quotes.flavor: The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

quotes.name: Scuttlemutt
quotes.flavor: Built to shuttle goods from the river, it took off one day carrying a cauldron of dyes.

quotes.name: Sorcerer of the Fang
quotes.flavor: "The Great Serpent slumbers now, but all warmbloods will grovel in the dirt at its awakening!"

quotes.name: Strongarm Tactics
quotes.flavor: "If you can't pay your gambling debts, you just might be tomorrow's main attraction at the Grand Coliseum."

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.flavor: Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.

quotes.name: Erestor of the Council
quotes.flavor: "There are but two courses: to hide the Ring forever; or to unmake it."

quotes.name: Two-Headed Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"That which would be a fatal mutation in any other species is merely a source of new powers. I am intrigued, yet too fearful to examine it more closely."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Drowned Catacomb
quotes.flavor: None can tell how many vessels are tangled up on the sea floor—or how much treasure remains unclaimed.

quotes.name: Ambitious Farmhand // Seasoned Cathar
quotes.flavor: "The cathars have taught me many things, but I will never forget the hard, honest work that first callused my hands."

quotes.name: Skullclamp
quotes.flavor: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

quotes.name: Beacon Behemoth
quotes.flavor: When its smoky plumes light Naya's sky, every creature from the smallest pip fawn to the largest rannet heeds the warning.

quotes.name: A-Sewer Crocodile
quotes.flavor:
"Quick, let's hide in the sewer!"
—Ginsi the Thief, now deceased

quotes.name: Leeching Bite
quotes.flavor: A substantial portion of Vorinclex's forces became fuel for the rest.

quotes.name: Champion of Dusk
quotes.flavor: "Drench these golden streets in the blood of our enemies."

quotes.name: Freewind Falcon
quotes.flavor:
"That does it! I'm going back to hunting chickens!"
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

quotes.name: Battle Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"One emitted a strange series of buzzing clicks and guttural commands, then clawed arms emerged from all of them. Is there no limit to their adaptations?"
—Hastric, Thunian scout

quotes.name: Flash Flood
quotes.flavor: Many people say that no power can bring the mountains low. Many people are fools.

quotes.name: Krenko's Command
quotes.flavor: Goblins are eager to follow orders, especially when those orders involve stealing, hurting, annoying, eating, destroying, or swearing.

quotes.name: Intangible Virtue
quotes.flavor:
"A real soldier's bravery comes from within ... from his heart and his soul."
—Elder Arthur Maxson

quotes.name: Sneaky Homunculus
quotes.flavor: Keep watch only for the giants and you'll be eaten by the ants.

quotes.name: Two-Headed Hellkite
quotes.flavor: Eons ago, the ur-dragon roared. Its descendants still carry the echo across the Multiverse.

quotes.name: Grey Host Reinforcements
quotes.flavor:
"I hope they haven't forgotten how to fight."
—Gimli

quotes.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
quotes.flavor:
"Come now, dear brother. If you wanted rules, you should have called it a *game*, not a *war*."
—Gisa, to Geralf

quotes.name: Marauding Raptor
quotes.flavor:
"Stand still and try not to look like prey!"
—Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide

quotes.name: Alaborn Grenadier
quotes.flavor:
"Ever proud, ever vigilant."
—Grenadier motto

quotes.name: Cackling Imp
quotes.flavor: Its laughter drives needles through your mind.

quotes.name: Valorous Stance
quotes.flavor:
"Every choice alters the path of fate."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Grim Lavamancer
quotes.flavor: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

quotes.name: Wight of the Reliquary
quotes.flavor: Her new demonic overlords prized her knowledge of Bant's landscape.

quotes.name: Flesh Carver
quotes.flavor: "Just a taste?"

quotes.name: Ardenvale Tactician // Dizzying Swoop
quotes.flavor: In a castle that prizes loyalty above all, the bond between knight and griffin is unmatched.

quotes.name: Glimmer of Genius
quotes.flavor: Creators live for that moment of inspiration: precious, profound, perfect.

quotes.name: Faithless Looting
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

quotes.name: Wall of Denial
quotes.flavor: It provides what every discerning mage requires—time to think.

quotes.name: Dreadbore
quotes.flavor: In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.

quotes.name: Deathcult Rogue
quotes.flavor:
"The hussars can't catch him, and he evades our traps with ease. I fear he walks unseen even in the halls of New Prahv."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

quotes.name: Wraith, Vicious Vigilante
quotes.flavor: Using tech impounded from her various arrests, Captain Yuri Watanabe took the law into her own hands.

quotes.name: Horobi, Death's Wail
quotes.flavor:
"Wherever it went, death came to Phyrexians and Kamigawans alike."
—*Records of the Living Historians*

quotes.name: Rat in the Hat
quotes.flavor: While the gremlin, beeble, and squirrel infestations wreaked havoc on the park, Roxi was able to spin the numerous rat colonies as a "robust recycling program."

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

quotes.name: Leonin Scimitar
quotes.flavor: "Our enemies may be more metal than flesh. Good reason to wield a blade that will cut either."

quotes.name: Silvercoat Lion
quotes.flavor:
"In the wild, white fur like mine is an aberration. We lack natural camouflage, but the inability to hide encourages other strengths."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Leyline Axe
quotes.flavor: It awaits a worthy wielder.

quotes.name: Dregscape Zombie
quotes.flavor: The undead of Grixis are fueled by their hatred of the living.

quotes.name: Faerie Impostor
quotes.flavor: Many Tin Street shops display a sign on the door: "No cloaks allowed."

quotes.name: Ravenous Squirrel
quotes.flavor:
"Nope, no monsters in the forest. Nothing in there but squirrels."
—Joskun, An-Havva constable

quotes.name: Sinew Dancer
quotes.flavor: To resist the embrace of the Flesh Singularity is to reject unconditional acceptance.

quotes.name: Harrow
quotes.flavor: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

quotes.name: Primal Huntbeast
quotes.flavor:
"To the unskilled, it appears as blurred patches of distorted light. Few have seen its true form."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Vindictive Mob
quotes.flavor: Many minds, a single madness.

quotes.name: Majestic Heliopterus
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Its rise is like the sun's, a beautiful beginning. Its descent is like the sun's, a frightful ending."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Otherworldly Journey
quotes.flavor:
"The landscape shimmered and I felt a chill breeze. When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends."
—Journal found in Numai

quotes.name: Conjurer's Closet
quotes.flavor:
"Tomorrow wears yesterday's face."
—Kordel the Cryptic

quotes.name: Deathleaper, Terror Weapon
quotes.flavor: Created to break will and bone with equal ferocity.

quotes.name: Spotted Griffin
quotes.flavor: When the cat flies and the bird stalks, guard your horses carefully.

quotes.name: Sifter Wurm
quotes.flavor:
"Rhonas's monument belongs to the wurms now. Look elsewhere for refuge."
—Arnun, vizier of the menagerie

quotes.name: Teysa Karlov
quotes.flavor: Her uncanny predictions of Phyrexian movements saved countless lives, though she never revealed the source of her information.

quotes.name: Desolate Mire
quotes.flavor: Silence, the poetry of a whispering wind, the centurial fall of tar on pale sand.

quotes.name: Collected Company
quotes.flavor: Many can stand where one would fall.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Revoker
quotes.flavor:
"These skittering creatures were created to hunt the one true threat to Phyrexia: dissent."
—Venser, journal

quotes.name: Ragged Recluse // Odious Witch
quotes.flavor: "Forgive my manners. It's been so long since I had a guest for dinner."

quotes.name: Epic Confrontation
quotes.flavor: No matter the timeline, some legends will endure.

quotes.name: Kruin Striker
quotes.flavor: Unhappy with the creation of the wolfir, Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

quotes.name: Flame Sweep
quotes.flavor:
"I have calculated that a dragon in flight, in a single strafing run, can cover an area of—"
—Thaedus the Clever, last words

quotes.name: Kiln Fiend
quotes.flavor: It traps an explosion within its stony skin.

quotes.name: Hellkite Igniter
quotes.flavor: Its flight sets the sky itself on fire.

quotes.name: Hour of Defeat
quotes.flavor:
"Tomorrow's sun will rise on a new king of Wakanda!"
—Erik Killmonger

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Battle Squadron
quotes.flavor: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.

quotes.name: Crippling Chill
quotes.flavor: One breath of the geist turns veins to rivers of ice and freezes hearts midbeat.

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"They distrust my methods, but when they want results, whom do you think they seek?"
—*Incantations of Lim-Dûl*

quotes.name: Rubblebelt Maaka
quotes.flavor:
"The maaka remain loyal to us in this time of strife. We don't even have to feed them—our enemies do."
—Nedja, Gruul shaman

quotes.name: Triskaidekaphile
quotes.flavor: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.

quotes.name: Tombfire
quotes.flavor: The fondest memories burn brightest. As they're lost forever, the flames grow hotter still.

quotes.name: Magus of the Candelabra
quotes.flavor:
"What would Urza think, I wonder, if he could hear how the nature mages still snarl at his name, but venerate the work of his apprentice?"
—Teferi, to Jhoira

quotes.name: Blood Artist
quotes.flavor:
"Vanya Falkenrath's paintings are astonishing. How does she manage to achieve such rich crimson hues?"
—Stefan, art critic

quotes.name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
quotes.flavor: The thoughtweft guides his hands with the will of an entire clachan, so his strikes land ever true.

quotes.name: Rambunctious Mutt
quotes.flavor: Emphatic words with powerful gestures. Clearly this was playtime.

quotes.name: Salt Marsh
quotes.flavor:
Only death breeds in stagnant water.
—Urborg saying

quotes.name: Balefire Dragon
quotes.flavor: If it comes for you, die boldly or die swiftly—for die you will.

quotes.name: Simic Signet
quotes.flavor: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

quotes.name: Maw of the Mire
quotes.flavor: As the chapel was dragged under, the bell in the tower rang until the murky depths forever silenced its toll.

quotes.name: Mogg Fanatic
quotes.flavor: "I got it! I got it! I—"

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: Suddenly as they drew nearer, a terrific baying and barking broke out, and a loud voice was heard shouting: "Grip! Fang! Wolf! Come on, lads!"

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor: All that glitters is yours.

quotes.name: Ghost Ship
quotes.flavor: Going down with the ship is just the beginning.

quotes.name: Screamer-Killer
quotes.flavor: Its shriek is unintelligible, but armored bulkheads seem to understand the intent well enough.

quotes.name: Circular Logic
quotes.flavor:
OBEY THE LAW, THE LAW IS TO OBEY
OBEY THE LAW, THE LAW IS TO OBEY

quotes.name: Barter in Blood
quotes.flavor:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Assembled Alphas
quotes.flavor: There is always a toll to pay for passage.

quotes.name: Cabal Coffers
quotes.flavor: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun-and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

quotes.name: Half-Elf Monk
quotes.flavor: This fight was over the moment you picked up that clumsy cleaver of a sword.

quotes.name: Rivendell
quotes.flavor:
"Were I to go where my heart dwells, I would now be wandering in the fair valley of Rivendell."
—Aragorn

quotes.name: Borne Upon a Wind
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"I looked on Aragorn and thought how great and terrible a Lord he might have become, had he taken the Ring for himself. Not for naught does Mordor fear him."
—Legolas

quotes.name: Wanderer's Twig
quotes.flavor: For every tree who falls, there are countless sprouts waiting to rise.

quotes.name: Withering Torment
quotes.flavor: Each spindrell is the lingering consciousness of a survivor consumed by cellarspawn—a ragged, drifting remnant pulsing with constant psychic agony.

quotes.name: Eiganjo Uprising
quotes.flavor: Two different visions of freedom clashed at the gates of the Imperial Palace.

quotes.name: Lookout's Dispersal
quotes.flavor: Her song plucks the strings of the storm, shifting wind and storm into a harmony that will carry her ship to safety.

quotes.name: Tranquil Grove
quotes.flavor:
"Even the fiercest storm has a peaceful eye."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Ghor-Clan Rampager
quotes.flavor:
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?"
—Kroshkar, Gruul shaman

quotes.name: Disenchant
quotes.flavor:
"I implore you not to forget the horrors of the past. You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi heretic

quotes.name: Dawn Gryff
quotes.flavor: After facing so many horrors, the survivors of Videns parish couldn't comprehend the hope that the gryff represented.

quotes.name: Hoverstone Pilgrim
quotes.flavor: They scour for secrets in places too distant or dangerous for humans to tread.

quotes.name: Mutilate
quotes.flavor: Liliana developed a fondness for the moment when roaring becomes squealing.

quotes.name: Pendulum of Patterns
quotes.flavor: Its elaborate designs reveal secrets of aether's flow.

quotes.name: Might of Oaks
quotes.flavor: "Guess where I'm gonna plant this!"

quotes.name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
quotes.flavor: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

quotes.name: Prosthetic Injector
quotes.flavor: Why carry a subject to a surgical lab when you can bring the surgical lab to them?

quotes.name: Ion Storm
quotes.flavor: When enough artifacts lie too long in the same place, their magical radiation weakens reality, opening rifts of unpredictable destructive power.

quotes.name: Pyrotechnic Performer
quotes.flavor: "Let's get this party started."

quotes.name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
quotes.flavor: The earth walks, strongest of all.

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor: While it possesses potent venom, the giant spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

quotes.name: Guardian Sunmare
quotes.flavor: It'll satisfy your need for steed!

quotes.name: Preordain
quotes.flavor: In a Multiverse of endless possibilities, Aminatou decided to experience all of them.

quotes.name: Totally Lost
quotes.flavor: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

quotes.name: Icy Manipulator
quotes.flavor: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

quotes.name: Final Fortune
quotes.flavor:
Want all, lose all.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

quotes.name: Aether Hub
quotes.flavor: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

quotes.name: Eyes in the Skies
quotes.flavor:
"What root and branch cannot reach, our winged friends will attend to."
—Zunak, Selesnya strategist

quotes.name: Super Mutant Scavenger
quotes.flavor: Out in the wastelands, everything's a steal.

quotes.name: Architects of Will
quotes.flavor: This secret society of mages manipulates the beliefs and opinions of others.

quotes.name: Treetop Sentinel
quotes.flavor: Crian's patrols afford him plenty of opportunity to take potshots at the "dirtwalkers" far below.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Venomous Dragonfly
quotes.flavor: A pretty little death is still death.

quotes.name: Darien, King of Kjeldor
quotes.flavor:
"With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor. Those who followed were known as the kings of New Argive."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

quotes.name: Packsong Pup
quotes.flavor: A wolf pup is always dangerous, because a wolf pup is never alone.

quotes.name: Stitcher's Supplier
quotes.flavor: No part goes to waste.

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor:
"Find your peace on the Farplane. Leave Spira to the living."
—Auron

quotes.name: Master Decoy
quotes.flavor: A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again.

quotes.name: Citadel Castellan
quotes.flavor: "I am the first line of defense. You will not encounter the second."

quotes.name: Pashalik Mons
quotes.flavor: He liked naming things after himself and was insistent on proper punctuation.

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: Those who crave power for selfish ends find that it always floats just beyond their fingertips, forever maddeningly out of reach.

quotes.name: Hallowed Burial
quotes.flavor:
"I'd rather hear the screams of battle than the quiet that follows."
—Talara, elvish safewright

quotes.name: Zuko's Offense
quotes.flavor:
"Looks like I underestimated you."
—Zuko

quotes.name: Adrestia
quotes.flavor: The eagle: good luck to those who bear it, bad luck to those who see it.

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Pollen
quotes.flavor:
"I breathed deeply, and suddenly I knew not who or where I was."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

quotes.name: Gruul Charm
quotes.flavor:
"Not Gruul? Then die!"
—Borborygmos

quotes.name: Edge of Autumn
quotes.flavor: "At harvest are seeds of next year sown."

quotes.name: Unstable Obelisk
quotes.flavor: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.
